name: Stratum Maglock Flatfoot
description:
A low-profile slip-on shoe with a ferromagnetic outsole plate designed to interface with magnetic-lock flooring systems in industrial and transit environments. The upper is a plain stretch-mesh in grey or black, close-fitting and unremarkable. The sole is notably flat and slightly heavier than expected, with a visible seam where the mag-plate inserts.

A workhorse item for augmented laborers who spend shifts on maglocked gantries or transit car rooftops. The shoe itself is nothing special — the sole is everything. Replacement mag-plates are sold separately.
functionality: Ferromagnetic outsole plate provides passive magnetic-lock compatibility with standard industrial and transit maglocked surfaces. Plates are field-replaceable.
what_it_says: You work in places where falling is a real option. Practical to the point of indifference to aesthetics.
story_hooks: The mag-plate frequency is keyed to specific industrial zones — wearing these in the wrong facility sets off access alerts.
Someone has been leaving Stratum Flatfoots near transit maintenance hatches across the city — always one shoe, never a pair.
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Space Elevator Tether System

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian slip-on with minimalist upper and pronounced industrial sole. Sleek and purposeful from the ankle down, anonymous from the ankle up. Signals function over form—the kind of shoe that disappears into a worker's routine.
physical_description.fit: Close and sock-like through the upper, with elastic stretch-mesh conforming to the foot. The sole sits deliberately flat and grounded, creating a stable, magnetic-lock-ready platform.
physical_description.primary_material: Stretch-mesh upper (synthetic blend), ferromagnetic steel-composite plate in sole with reinforced polymer backing
physical_description.texture: Upper is soft and breathable with a fine mesh weave; sole is smooth on the magnet-contact face, slightly textured underfoot with a visible industrial seam line separating the mag-plate insert from the surrounding composite
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal grey or matte black upper; steel-grey ferromagnetic plate visible along sole perimeter
physical_description.closures: None—pure slip-on design for quick deck transitions
distinctive_features: Visible ferromagnetic plate seam running heel-to-toe
Slightly oversized sole profile extending beyond upper edge
Reinforced toe box for gantry work
Magnetic lock contact point marked with industrial hash marks
Replacement mag-plate cartridge slot clearly visible
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 working class / industrial augment user
physical_description.cultural_context: Transit workers, gantry laborers, augmented dock personnel, maglev maintenance crews. A shoe that says 'I work infrastructure' and has zero pretense about it.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and scuffed; ferromagnetic plate shows contact wear and minor surface corrosion; upper may have reinforced patches at stress points
